title: Airtable Interface gap analysis: UI protocol evaluation & roadmap
body:
Evaluates ObjectStack's UI Protocol against Airtable Interfaces to identify gaps and propose schema improvements. ObjectStack already exceeds Airtable in raw component capabilities (45+ chart types, Gantt/Map views, offline support, AI components, theming) but lacks the **composition layer** — the "Interface" abstraction that bundles pages into shareable, role-specific surfaces.

### New: `docs/design/airtable-interface-gap-analysis.md`

- **Feature comparison matrix** — 50+ features across 5 categories (page types, views, elements, permissions, sharing)
- **9 gaps identified**, prioritized P0–P2:
  - P0: No first-class `InterfaceSchema`, no Record Review page type, no standalone content elements (text/number/image/divider)
  - P1: No sharing/embedding config, no per-element data binding, no inline form element
  - P2: No user impersonation preview, no interface templates, no record picker element
- **17 ObjectStack advantages** documented (multi-level grouping, 6 form types, DnD protocol, i18n, responsive, animation, etc.)
- **5 schema proposals** with Zod code examples:

```typescript
// Proposed InterfaceSchema — self-contained shareable surface
export const InterfaceSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().regex(/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/),
  label: z.string(),
  pages: z.array(InterfacePageSchema),
  sharing: SharingConfigSchema.optional(),
  assignedRoles: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});
```

- **4-phase implementation roadmap**: Phase A (v3.2) → Phase D (v4.1)
- Risk analysis and decision log

### Modified: `ROADMAP.md`

- Added **§8.1 UI Protocol Enhancement** with phased deliverables (A–D)
- Updated versioning plan (v3.2–v4.1) to include UI protocol milestones
- Added Interface Builder to Studio IDE section
- Cross-linked design document in Related Documents
